definitions.explanation: Training that involves actual practice in the field, as opposed to theoretical study.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}で{実習|じっしゅう}をする。
examples.english: I do practical training at a hospital.

examples.japanese: {教育|きょういく}{実習|じっしゅう}で{小学校|しょうがっこう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to an elementary school for teaching practice.

examples.japanese: {実習|じっしゅう}を{通|とお}じて{多|おお}くのことを{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned a lot through practical training.

notes:
{実習|じっしゅう} combines {実|じつ} (actual/real) + {習|しゅう} (learning).

COMMON TYPES:
- {教育|きょういく}{実習|じっしゅう} (teaching practice)
- {看護|かんご}{実習|じっしゅう} (nursing practice)
- {臨床|りんしょう}{実習|じっしゅう} (clinical practice)
- {技能|ぎのう}{実習|じっしゅう} (technical training)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {実習|じっしゅう}をする/を{行|おこな}う (to do practical training)
- {実習|じっしゅう}{生|せい} (trainee, intern)
- {実習|じっしゅう}{先|さき} (place of internship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実習|じっしゅう}: practical training (academic/professional)
- インターンシップ: internship (from English)
- {研修|けんしゅう}: training (professional development)
